variants.headline: State payments fall short
variants.body: State wages, unemployment benefit and pensions have all been paid short by the same share. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.

variants.headline: Equal cuts, different household needs
variants.body: The government has underpaid wages, unemployment benefit and pensions, each by an equal proportion. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.

variants.headline: Treasury pays less than it owes
variants.body: Government payments have fallen short across state wages, unemployment benefit and pensions alike. Our principles require political attention that keeps the purpose of public responsibility firmly in view here.
